why_it_fails: Pure identity gate on an address-format/number mismatch. locators._known_menu_candidates reads the Sweed directory (GetStoreShortInfoList); for each branch `exact = addresses_match(registry, directory address) or _pinned(store, branch.location.coords)`. addresses_match("1210 W Glen Ave", "1204 West Glen Avenue, Peoria, Illinois") fails on the street number, and `_pinned` cannot rescue it because the short-info list has location=null (the coordinates only exist on the branch page's own GetStoreInfoV2). A same-city non-exact branch is returned as status "identity_conflict" with a URL, which resolve_menu records as a failure and never fetches. The verifier leads (/peoria, /peoria/menu) do not help: the page-level check provider_address_matches(site_discovery L295) uses `platform_location` (Jane) or the `retailer_address` string; Sweed observe() stores `retailer_location` (not `platform_location`), so the string comparison fails again -> "Detected menu belongs to a different street address". The recent commit b077228 (Dutchie street number off by one digit pair) does not cover 1204 vs 1210 and is Dutchie-only.
fix_idea: Shared Sweed/directory fix: (1) in _known_menu_candidates, for a same-city branch whose street name matches but number differs, return status "candidate" (not identity_conflict) so the branch page is fetched; (2) in provider_address_matches treat Sweed `retailer_location.coords` exactly like Jane `platform_location` (<=0.35 mi -> True, >5 mi -> False); this proves Peoria (0.027 mi) and keeps real conflicts out. Would also unblock other Aroma Hill/Sweed chains whose directory address differs in format (e.g. Fox Lake a6e621f4.., id 262 "1298 U.S. 12"). Then Peoria resolves to sweed 263 at /peoria/menu (recreational) with ~644 products.
